# Analytics

Track bot usage over time with this TypeScript bot template.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/analytics" title="@robojs/analytics" description="Analytics plugin for Robo.js." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/analytics-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Command usage tracking
- User activity metrics
- Server growth analytics
- Custom event tracking

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
